codex.name: Codex
codex.note: AGENTS.override.md takes precedence in the same directory. Start a new session after installation.

claude.name: Claude Code
claude.note: Use /memory to inspect loaded instructions. Project settings can exclude instruction sources.

cursor.name: Cursor
cursor.preamble:
---
description: Proportionate work, concrete judgment, and complete delivery.
alwaysApply: true
---
cursor.note: The adapter includes alwaysApply: true. A plain .md file in .cursor/rules is not a project rule.

copilot.name: GitHub Copilot
copilot.note: Instruction support differs between chat, code review, CLI, and IDE clients. Check the linked support matrix.

gemini.name: Gemini CLI
gemini.note: Use /memory show to inspect context and /memory reload to refresh it. Custom context.fileName settings can change discovery.

opencode.name: OpenCode
opencode.note: Codex and OpenCode share the project AGENTS.md. Installing both updates the same managed block.
